g1.label: 1. Obama won the election in
g1.why: Obama won the presidential election in 2008.

g2.label: 2. Journalists described the USA as
g2.why: Some journalists claimed his win made America 'post-racial'.

g3.label: 3. Obama himself was
g3.why: Obama was cautious about the post-racial claim.

g4.label: 4. His presidency expanded
g4.why: His presidency saw healthcare coverage expanded.

g5.label: 5. Police killings led to the rise of
g5.why: Killings of unarmed Black people gave rise to Black Lives Matter.

g6.label: 6. Kaepernick protested by
g6.why: He knelt during the national anthem as a protest.

g1.label: 1. Obama ___
g1.why: A finished action at a stated past time takes the past simple.

g2.label: 2. Since leaving office, he ___
g2.why: 'Since' with a period reaching the present takes the present perfect.

g3.label: 3. Kaepernick ___
g3.why: A completed action at a definite past point takes the past simple.

g4.label: 4. Many athletes ___
g4.why: Present perfect for actions in a period that is still open.

g5.label: 5. The Black Lives Matter movement ___
g5.why: The growth continues up to now, so the present perfect is used.

g6.label: 6. The 2008 financial crisis ___
g6.why: A dated past event takes the past simple.

g7.label: 7. Historians ___
g7.why: The debate is still going on, so the present perfect fits.

g8.label: 8. Obama ___
g8.why: Leaving office happened at a definite past time: past simple.

g1.label: 1. Obama became president ___
g1.why: The past simple pairs with a finished time expression like 'in 2009'.

g2.label: 2. The debate has continued ___
g2.why: 'For' + a length of time goes with the present perfect.

g3.label: 3. Kaepernick has protested ___
g3.why: 'Since' marks the starting point of a period continuing now.

g4.label: 4. The financial crisis hit the economy ___
g4.why: A finished year takes the past simple, not the present perfect.

g5.label: 5. ___ (sentence opener)
g5.why: 'So far' means up to now and goes with the present perfect.

g6.label: 6. BLM has organised protests ___
g6.why: 'This decade' is an unfinished period, so the present perfect is used.

g7.label: 7. Obama gave his farewell speech ___
g7.why: A specific finished date takes the past simple.

g8.label: 8. He ___
g8.why: 'Just' with a very recent action takes the present perfect.
